saw_lines: Outdoor light buyers choose by how a set looks on their own house, then rebuy the same product each year.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before a buyer sees a reason to click.
Your site offers up to 50% off, yet 0 of 28 copy ads mention it, so put the offer in the first line of three new ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers up to 50% off, yet 0 of 28 copy ads mention it. A buyer scrolling past has no reason to click today. Put the offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

0 of 28 copy ads lead with a proof number, so a buyer comparing outdoor lights has nothing to trust. Collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.

8 of 28 copy ads open on “this is your sign to”, so most of your set repeats one story. A shopper sees the same hook again. Test two new angles against it, price and quick installation, in three ads each.

5 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product in the ad. Buyers then hunt for the light, and some leave. Point each of the 5 to its own product page, the way your ConnectGo icicle ads do.
